subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Future of Behavioral Policy
description: One-minute skill: Future of Behavioral Policy.

hook.text: AI can now personalize nudges in real time. Your phone knows your spending habits and could intervene before an impulse.

buildup.text: Personalized nudges match interventions to people using data. One person needs a savings reminder.

discovery.text: Mills proposed personalized defaults: instead of one default for everyone, algorithms pick the best default for each.

twist.text: Personalized nudges require personal data. The same data can nudge for good or exploit for profit.

climax.text: Behavioral policy's future lies in personalization and AI, but only with strong data governance, transparency,.

punchline.text: Smarter nudges need smarter safeguards. Power should match accountability.

quiz.question: What is the main risk of personalized AI nudges?
options: They are too expensive to implement
The same personal data can be used to exploit rather than help
